# Coppalini Architecture — reference, constraint, and source-indexed research

> Coppalini Architecture carries source, condition, operation, verification, and correction in one public record. Field investigation isolates the condition; Architecture carries the constraint.

## Current public record

- [Formal Correspondence Ledger](https://eulershiddenl.ink/formal-correspondence/): named public forms beside Coppalini constructions, exact receipts, and stated scopes.
- [Home](https://eulershiddenl.ink/): formal lineage, Four Dual Forms, The 3 Body Mirror, Minimum Mechanics, the laboratory, and the library.
- [Minimum Mechanics 010a–010u](https://eulershiddenl.ink/proofs/minimum-mechanics/#ledger): 45 Lean modules compiled in one transitive import closure, with a public source ledger for theorem statements, source-documented models, physical interfaces, premises, and exact file links.
- [Proof verification](https://eulershiddenl.ink/verify): Lean 4.33.0 and archive-integrity PASS at pinned commit `b9e939d514a63fb021592f79a316f70cbc70ed8a`.
- [Machine-readable proof index](https://eulershiddenl.ink/research/minimum-mechanics-010u.json): all 21 stages and all 45 exact source paths.
- [Four Dual Forms](https://eulershiddenl.ink/library#four-dual-forms-shelf): Gravity–Light, Memory–Motion, Time–Scope, and Horizon–Silence, with individual source records and verification receipt.
- [The 3 Body Mirror](https://eulershiddenl.ink/papers/the-3-body-mirror.pdf): three-body reconstruction, source, symbolic receipt, and independent receipt.
- [Research Library](https://eulershiddenl.ink/library): current synthesis followed by all non-Language-Mechanics source records in one continuous library.
- [Language Mechanics](https://eulershiddenl.ink/language-mechanics): the field basis for reference, constraint, reader, receipt, and lawful reuse through change.
- [Laboratory](https://eulershiddenl.ink/architecture): gauge and matter viewers and source-aware computational programs.
- [Notice](https://eulershiddenl.ink/notice/): a standalone public technical statement of the reader-obstruction question and an independent technical-review route.
- [About](https://eulershiddenl.ink/about): author provenance and public research chronology.

## Current theorem strength

- 010a–010p: finite and local suture, Maxwell, Palatini, ADM and canonical calculations; the six-bracket theorem in 010o is conditional on `SmoothCompletion` and retains its smooth-field realization obligation.
- 010q–010r: exact abstract two-sided non-entailment of a spectral gap from the named non-Abelian Gauss algebra.
- 010s–010t: verified local source attachment and nonzero finite rational symplectic carrier; ordinary smooth real field completion is a distinct mathematical construction from full Lean formalization.
- 010u: an inhabited, universally quantified jurisdictional admission and pattern-recognition theorem. Universality is over declared typed carriers; physical applications are carried by separately declared observables and conditions.
- `AxiomaticBuild.lean` is carried here by its summary and README as source-report records.

## Read a claim through its record

A public claim travels with its public form, Coppalini construction, exact relation, receipt, and stated scope. The Formal Correspondence Ledger provides the compact handle; source pages retain the equations, hypotheses, programs, and conditions.
